original_finding_text:
- [P1] Support accepted directory scopes through matrix preparation — /Users/nv/repos/ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi/.codex-worktrees/issue-throughput-handoff-2026-09-06-g5a02cbbad3/scripts/sentinel/main.ts:2073-2079
  When a planner emits `src/`, `tests/`, or any other directory scope, this validator now accepts it, but `writePreparedMatrixPlan` still passes the trailing-slash path directly to `isSentinelProtectedImplementationPath` and throws. This moves the failure outside the per-issue planning handler, aborting matrix preparation instead of advancing the queue. Normalizing that later check alone is insufficient: `buildMatrixPlan` also rejects `src/` and `tests/` because they overlap the supplied protected descendants. Make directory handling consistent through matrix preparation while retaining per-file protection, and test the accepted plan through that path.
normalization: Removed exact canonical worktree prefix from paths for repository-relative finding fingerprints.
